name: asset-l10-dispersal-control
note: L10 control platform with stair and the console next to it, courier for scale. Look for: stair reaches the ground, railings closed, console screens readable (progress screen teal), console grounded. The game camera never zooms out past 1.0 (about 20 m across): pieces taller or wider than that are seen in part, which is the intended monumental read.
